front.title: Path Computation Element Communication Protocol (PCEP) Extensions for DiffServ in SR Policy

abstract.t: This document defines extensions to the Path Computation Element Communication Protocol (PCEP) for associating a Differentiated Services (DiffServ) Per-Hop Behavior (PHB) with a Segment Routing (SR) Policy candidate path. It introduces a new TLV that is carried in the LSP object used to signal an SR Policy candidate path. The TLV publishes the binding between the SR Policy candidate path and a PHB.
